Video on car needs Play-source install. Tap for steps.
Play-source install OK — open CarTube from AA apps (navigation).
Android Auto blocks template (video surface) apps unless they are installed with Google Play as the installer package. Unknown sources does not fix this.

Windows steps: enable USB debugging, connect phone, run platform-tools adb. Uninstall CarTube first. From the folder containing cartube-debug.apk run the command below. Full guide: docs/VIDEO_ON_CAR.md in the repo.
No PC? Use Shizuku plus UnknownAuto on the phone (GitHub) to install with Play attribution. Root not required on most devices.
After reinstall: Android Auto developer Unknown sources ON, Customize launcher, pick CarTube under apps/navigation (not Media only), then Send to car on the phone.
